::: {.decision}
**Your decision.** Take the baseline 90-day US$1 million invoice. A US$300,000 customer receipt is certain on the same date. The treasury team can buy dollars forward at HK$7.81 per US dollar. Should it buy the full million?
:::

<div id="worked-example"></div>

## Offset same-day receipts before booking the forward

The receipt can settle part of the invoice. Net exposure is **US$700,000**. At settlement spot rates of 7.75 and 7.85, buying the residual costs HK$5,425,000 or HK$5,495,000. A forward purchase of 700,000 fixes that outlay at **HK$5,467,000**. These are illustrative treasury quotes with no fees or collateral calls.

A million-dollar forward costs HK$7,810,000. After paying the invoice, the firm has the customer’s US$300,000 left to sell at spot. Net HK-dollar outlay is therefore HK$5,485,000 at 7.75 or HK$5,455,000 at 7.85. Hedging the gross invoice reverses the direction of the residual exposure.

## Resize the hedge when the invoice changes

**What changes if the supplier reduces its invoice to US$960,000 under the tariff scenario?**

<details><summary>Work through the decision</summary><p>Assuming the same US$300,000 receipt, the net invoice exposure becomes US$660,000. The previous 700,000 forward overhedges by 40,000. Track any duty payable separately by currency and settlement date. If the receipt arrives late, a matched net hedge still leaves a temporary dollar funding need.</p></details>

(() => {
  const lab = document.getElementById('currency-hedging-lab');
  const form = lab.querySelector('form');
  const format = n => n.toLocaleString('en-US', {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2});
  const money = n => 'HK$' + format(n);
  const usd = n => 'US$' + format(n);
  function calculate(inputs) {
    const [forward,timing,spot]=inputs;
const receipt=timing==='On time'?300000:0, gap=1000000-forward-receipt;
const cost=forward*7.81+gap*spot;
return {rows:[['Today · book forward',usd(forward)+' at HK$7.81'],['Day 90 · dollars received',usd(forward)+' forward + '+usd(receipt)+' customer'],['Day 90 · invoice',usd(1000000)],['Day 90 · spot transaction',gap===0?'None':(gap<0?'Sell ':'Buy ')+usd(Math.abs(gap))],['Day 90 · uncovered dollars',usd(Math.max(0,gap))],['Day 90 · net HKD outlay',money(cost)],['Day 97 · customer receipt',usd(timing==='One week late'?300000:0)]],math:'Day 90 outlay = forward dollars × 7.81 + remaining dollar purchase × spot. Treasury must source any dollars left uncovered on day 90.':'Match the hedge to US$700,000 after the confirmed receipt. A larger forward leaves surplus dollars to sell.'};
  }
  function refresh() {
    const inputs = Array.from(form.querySelectorAll('select'), field => Number.isFinite(Number(field.value)) ? Number(field.value) : field.value);
    const result = calculate(inputs);
    const table = document.createElement('table');
    table.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Scenario results');
    for (const [label, value] of result.rows) {
      const row = table.insertRow();
      const heading = document.createElement('th');
      heading.scope = 'row';
      heading.textContent = label;
      row.append(heading);
      row.insertCell().textContent = value;
    }
    const output = lab.querySelector('.scenario-result');
    output.replaceChildren(table);
    if (result.bars) {
      const maximum = Math.max(...result.bars.map(item => item[1]));
      for (const [label, value] of result.bars) {
        const line = document.createElement('p');
        const bar = document.createElement('meter');
        bar.max = maximum;
        bar.value = value;
        bar.setAttribute('aria-label', label);
        line.append(label + ' ', bar, ' ' + value);
        output.append(line);
      }
    }
    lab.querySelector('.scenario-math').textContent = result.math;
    lab.querySelector('.scenario-call').textContent = result.call;
  }
  form.addEventListener('change', refresh);
  form.addEventListener('reset', () => requestAnimationFrame(refresh));
  refresh();
})();
